title: Custom Hyperion
description: This project adds a Hyperion concept, just very different and survival friendly (not OP)...
body:
# Custom Hyperion

Join the Runeshard Discord today: https://discord.gg/NSYFkbbjjZ - Would appricate every single new member!

Custom Hyperion is a Mod created by Runeshard Studios which will provide you following:

- Brand new weapon for survival
- Custom texture
- An implosion like in Hypixel Skyblock with a 7x7 monster hit radius (up to 10 blocks forward) (collision on blocks) - Dealing a lot of damage - 15 seconds cooldown
- 8 left click damage
- Not enchantable - You can only combine it in an anvil using another Hyperion to repair it


<details>
<summary>Commands</summary>

## Commands

```
/chyperion (admin)
```
to obtain a custom Hyperion. Add "admin" behind it to gain a Hyperion (same texture) which has no cooldown.

![Command for the custom Hyperion](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2915119ca96545fd24a130e1aa85c7a5284ae0d4.png)
</details>

<details>
<summary>Where to find the Hyperion?</summary>

## Where to find it?

You can simply find it very rarely in jungle temples in survival. It can be enchanted like any other weapon. It has a 3% chance to spawn.
This weapon can not be enchanted with anything, which would make it too OP. It can be repaired with another Hyperion to gain durability back.
</details>


<details>
<summary>Requirements</summary>

## Requirements

[Fabric 1.21.1 installed](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/)

[Fabric API 1.21.1 installed](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api/versions)
</details>
